_patch.note_add: Osceola County's 2026 rate sheet (approved May 5, 2026) gave $24 for a basic site, $27 for a standard site and $33 for a premium waterfront site, with the same $5 booking fee; premium sites take 3 nights on weekends and holidays.  Every vehicle needs a county parking permit, $8 a day or $30 a year.

_patch.note_add: Delta County's 2026 rates agree: $40 for water and electric and $45 for full hookups or a river or lake view, plus a non-refundable $5 reservation fee on a booking made ahead; holiday weekends take 2 nights.
_patch.source_add: ; https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/rates-fees-policies/ (2026 rates and the reservation fee), read 2026-10-13

_patch.note_add: Forsyth Township's 2023 rate sheet gives the same $25 and $38.
The City of Ironwood's 2026 rates agree: $30 for 30-amp electric, $35 for 50-amp and $40 for full hookups, or $250 a week with full hookups.
The City of Marquette's 2026 rates agree: $30 for a primitive site, $45 electric and $55 full hookup, with the same $7 reservation fee; stays are limited to 14 nights.

fees.note: Read on the Campspot marketplace, which lists Baker River together with Riverbrook, its sister campground a mile away: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, both of Baker River's RV site types (Compact Water & Electric Sites and Water & Electric Sites).  June 2027: $47-53 on a Tuesday; $49-55 on a Saturday.  The compact sites were quoted; the larger sites' rates are Campspot's list prices less the $4 booking fee they include.  Campspot offers no sites in October 2026 and January 2027.  Plus the park's $4 'BAKER: Booking Fee', once per stay.  Read 2026-10-13.

_patch.note_add: The park's 2026 rates page gives $39 for water and electric and $44 for full hookups off-season (May 1-21 and September 28-October 31), $44 and $50 in peak season, and $49 and $55 on holiday weekends, which take 3 nights; rates cover 2 adults and 3 children, and the 7th night is free.

fees.note: From the park's 2026 rates page (read 2026-10-13): water-and-electric sites are $46 a night, full-hookup pull-throughs $48 and full-hookup back-ins $56, each for up to 4 people, plus $5 for each additional person 6 or older; the park gives a 10% military discount.  Weekends from March to December take 2 nights, and holiday weekends 3.  The park books through ResNexus; it is no longer on Campspot.
